trigger: Convoy staging at the warehouses. Sgt. Ruiz briefs drivers.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Mid-November. Sleet. Thirty trucks of warehouse stock lined up for Donner Pass. Army MRAPs at each end.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: You're the mechanic. Pearce. I'm Ruiz, Engineer Two. You ride the lead truck. If it stops, you start it.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: The Directive says this food feeds Sacramento. Sacramento's eating rats. I've seen it. That's the truth.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Reno eats what's left. I know. I don't love it. I'm a combat engineer, not a philosopher.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Orders are paper. I follow the ones I can live with. Today I can live with this one. Barely.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Smart. Say nothing. It's the only thing they can't requisition.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Compact's blocking the canyon. Farmers with deer rifles and hay trucks. If they shoot, we shoot. Please don't make me.
